## Recall · Settings and rules

a) Your AI tool uses your chats for training. What do you do?
b) Which account do you use for course work?
c) Where do you read what you may do with the output of a tool?

::: {.answer}
a) Switch the training off, if you can.
b) the university account
c) in the terms of use
:::

## Recall · A safe prompt and a statement

a) A prompt has a customer's name and phone number. What do you do?
b) Where do you add the real name?
c) Where does the AI-use statement go?

::: {.answer}
a) Use [Customer], and leave the phone number out.
b) in Word, after the AI answered
c) at the end of the work
:::

## Summary

- Check the settings: the chat history, the training and the account.
- Follow the rules of the course, read the terms of use, and respect copyright.
- A safe prompt keeps the task and hides who the person is; add the real details in Word.
- An AI-use statement names the tool, the use, the changes and the checks.
